The goal is to keep the working Godot/text-choice/OpenAI-agent stack, but retarget the creative surface and room structure:
- Verne inside the ship: procedure, compartments, pressure, repairs, route calculation, crew work, instruments, constrained resources.
- Lovecraft outside the airlock: old evidence, impossible signals, contaminated records, alien ruins, pressure on perception, dread by accumulation.
- Runtime scripts, data loaders, command input, text console, combat fallback, follow-up scheduler, and scenario tooling were copied from Fleshpunk.
- Public-domain Verne/Lovecraft corpus files were copied into `generated/corpus/`.
- Fleshpunk room, event, deck, enemy, mutation, and symbiote data has been removed from the active data layer. New Nightmare Voyage content starts from scratch.
- TTS audio files were intentionally not copied. Regenerate audio only after the first Nightmare Voyage text slice is accepted.
- The forward "room" unit is now a captain-facing encounter packet: detection, officer reports, captain authorization, operation result, and delayed ship/crew consequence.
Build a 10-room vertical slice before broad conversion.
- `run_manager.gd`: resource counters, action handlers, deck construction, delayed follow-ups.
- `world.gd`: presentation and command routing. Keep the text-first console loop.
- `ship_dashboard.gd`: console UI, renamed from the inherited Fleshpunk dashboard script.
- `rooms_post_update.json`, `events_post_update.json`, `encounter_decks_post_update.json`: active Nightmare Voyage starter packet set.
- `.agent-memory/hymn_corpus_voice.md`: still used by tooling, retargeted here as the ship-report voice guide.
- `.agent-memory/nightmare_voyage_mechanics.md`: first-pass officer stress, operation plans, chance, and outcome machinery.
- `.agent-memory/nightmare_voyage_style.md`: compact style rules for this fork.
- An encounter starts with detection, officer interpretation, and a captain-level decision.
- A room/packet has a concrete ship function, intercepted-object function, or exterior evidence function.
- Choices change a ship system, crew state, route state, exposure state, or future signal/contamination pressure.
- The prose remains short enough for mobile text-choice play.
- The outside threat is never explained faster than the instruments can fail.
